title: Fan-out-two circuit conversion
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $C$ be a directed acyclic circuit with $n$ input vertices. Suppose every gate has distinct input vertices, with one input for a negation gate and two inputs for a conjunction or disjunction gate. The fan-out reduction construction applied to $C$ defines another directed acyclic circuit with the same $n$ input vertices.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number of input vertices
An input directed acyclic circuit on those vertices
Conjunction and disjunction gates have two arguments
caveat: The provided statement omits the definition of the fan-out reduction construction, so its precise action on the gates and output vertex cannot be described from the supplied information.
